name: orion
description: Search, edit, research, import, and generate in your local Orion Spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Your local knowledge atlas, available in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Use Orion's local library and optional AI/context workflows from Codex. Search and cite exact notes, edit knowledge, import source material through Orion's synthesis flow, research evidence, generate notes and decks, and refresh canonical knowledge. Orion retains provider credentials and settings. Enable workflow Spaces, API use, and writes in Orion Connections. Inspect exact passages, sections, tasks, provenance, concepts and link paths. Make version-guarded edits and atomic metadata updates, and diagnose duplicates or broken references. Includes 41 tools across local knowledge and native AI workflows.
defaultPrompt: Research my Orion Space and cite the supporting evidence.
Import this material through Orion’s knowledge flow.
Generate a briefing from the notes in my Orion Space.
